## Projects

NATS JetStream, durable consumers, idempotency keys checked before side effects, retries with back-off, dead-letter queue, correlation IDs across HTTP and NATS. TypeScript, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Zod, Docker Compose.
- [MovieBook](https://github.com/sartha555k/moviebook): Seat booking with atomic Redis locks (SET NX PX) and TTL so two users cannot buy the same seat. React, Redux Toolkit, Express, MongoDB, Redis, JWT. Live: https://movie-booking-creative-upaay.vercel.app
- [Crack.AI](https://github.com/sartha555k/Crack.AI): AI mock interviews across 18+ roles. React, Node, MongoDB, FastAPI, Whisper, Ollama, Socket.IO, Monaco.
- [ResumeX](https://github.com/sartha555k/ResumeX): AI résumé builder with live preview, templates, export, share links. React 19, Redux Toolkit, Express, MongoDB, OpenAI API. Live: https://resume-x-8s55.vercel.app
- program-intel: Program intelligence dashboard for an education nonprofit; CSV ingestion, filters, risk tiers, traceable grant reporting. React, Node, MongoDB. Live: https://mantra-4-change.vercel.app
